_comment: Physical forms a solid reagent is dosed in (src/solid_forms.rs). `diameter_um` is the volume-equivalent grain diameter the dosed population starts with (a reagent entry may give its own `particle_um`, e.g. the thickness of a ribbon); `loose_pieces` marks forms that stay separate objects on the vessel floor and in the liquid (never a suspended slurry, never a settled bed): their morphology in the snapshot is `pieces`. A form not listed here leaves the solid's own grain size and morphology. Sizes are typical bench stock (a ribbon about 1 mm effective thickness, turnings 1-2 mm, granules 2-5 mm, a laboratory powder tens of micrometres); tier Estimated.
